<a id="bless_the_rains"></a>
## Soft-Rock: `bless_the_rains.yml`

An early-eighties soft-rock song in the manner of Africa, with a melody of its own: a marimba riff
in sixteenths, congas, a shaker and a cowbell, and a warm pad, the marimba moved through the chords
by Progression.

<a id="chord_progression_generator"></a>
## Progressions: `06_chord_progression_generator.yml`

A pop song in C major made from three patterns one bar long, an arpeggio, a bass figure and a
chord pad, each written over chord I and played through a Progression, a different one in every
scene: Pop, Fifties, Andalusian in A minor, Pachelbel's eight chords, Pop again with the pad's
chords inverted so that they move less, and Pop with the pad through a Voice leading generator.

## Synth-Pop: `goodnight_world.yml`

An early-eighties synth-pop song in the manner of Sweet Dreams, with a melody of its own: a
sixteenth-note synth bass leaping an octave, a cold string pad, a drum machine and a saw lead.

<a id="peanut_buttercup"></a>
## Soul-Pop: `peanut_buttercup.yml`

A late-sixties soul-pop song in the manner of Build Me Up Buttercup, with a melody of its own: a
bouncing piano, horn stabs on the off-beats and a tambourine on two and four, the harmony moved by
Progression chains.

<a id="rick_rolling"></a>
## Dance-Pop: `rick_rolling.yml`

A late-eighties dance-pop song in the manner of Never Gonna Give You Up, with a melody of its own:
an octave-bouncing synth bass, off-beat chord stabs and a disco beat. The bass and the stabs are one
bar each, moved through the chords by Progression chains.
